info.title: AnhTester Book Management API
info.description: A comprehensive API for managing books, users, categories, promotions, and addresses, provided by [AnhTester](https://anhtester.com). The API is designed to be easy to use and supports a wide range of operations for book management, user management, category management, promotion management, and address management.             UI page to run this API: [book.anhtester.com](https://book.anhtester.com)

tags.name: Authentication Management
tags.description: Manage user authentication, including creation and refresh of JWT tokens.

tags.name: User Management
tags.description: Manage user accounts, including creating, updating, and deleting user information.

tags.name: Book Management
tags.description: Manage book information, including creating, updating, and retrieving book lists.

tags.name: Category Management
tags.description: Manage book categories, including creating and updating category lists.

tags.name: Address Management
tags.description: Manage address information in Vietnam, including creation, retrieval, and updates.

tags.name: Promotion Management
tags.description: Manage promotions, update information, and provide promotion details.

get.description: Get all provincial-level divisions of Vietnam under the current 2-tier administrative system (effective 2025-07-01): 34 provinces / centrally-run cities, ordered by administrative code (Thành phố Hà Nội → Tỉnh Cà Mau). There is no district level any more.

get.summary: List wards / communes of a province
get.description: Get all commune-level divisions (phường, xã, đặc khu) of the given province, ordered by administrative code. `divname` must be the full name returned by `GET /api/address`, e.g. `Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh` (URL-encoded). Unknown name returns `[]`.

Query list of books (pagination, filtering, sorting). `picture` only lists files that exist. A plain-text `search` matches `name`, `description`, `slug`, `author`, `publisher` and `isbn`.

**Pricing rule.** `currentPrice` (selling price) is computed by the server and cannot be sent: `price` minus the discounts of the promotions attached to the book that are **in effect** (`isActive = true` and `startDate <= now <= endDate`). PERCENTAGE takes off `price * value / 100`, FIXED_AMOUNT takes off `value`, FREE_SHIPPING does not change the price; discounts of several promotions add up. The result is rounded to an integer and always stays within `[0, price]`. It is recalculated when the book (price, promotions) or any attached promotion changes, and when a promotion starts or ends.

currentPrice.description: Selling price after promotions in effect. Always between 0 and `price`.

promotions.description: Active, not yet expired promotions (includes scheduled ones that have not started).

post.description:
Create a new book. Returns **201**.

- `name` is trimmed and must not be blank; `slug` is normalized (`Đắc Nhân Tâm` → `dac-nhan-tam`) and must not end up empty.
- `price`: integer 0 – 1,000,000,000 (default 50,000).
- No `promotions` (or `[]`) → no promotion attached, `currentPrice = price`.
- `author`, `publisher`, `publishYear`, `pageCount`, `isbn`, `language` are optional (see the schema for limits); `null` or a blank string clears them.

**Pricing rule.** `currentPrice` (selling price) is computed by the server and cannot be sent: `price` minus the discounts of the promotions attached to the book that are **in effect** (`isActive = true` and `startDate <= now <= endDate`). PERCENTAGE takes off `price * value / 100`, FIXED_AMOUNT takes off `value`, FREE_SHIPPING does not change the price; discounts of several promotions add up. The result is rounded to an integer and always stays within `[0, price]`. It is recalculated when the book (price, promotions) or any attached promotion changes, and when a promotion starts or ends.

promotions.description: Promotion ids. Every id must exist (404 otherwise).

get.description:
Get a book by id or slug.

**Pricing rule.** `currentPrice` (selling price) is computed by the server and cannot be sent: `price` minus the discounts of the promotions attached to the book that are **in effect** (`isActive = true` and `startDate <= now <= endDate`). PERCENTAGE takes off `price * value / 100`, FIXED_AMOUNT takes off `value`, FREE_SHIPPING does not change the price; discounts of several promotions add up. The result is rounded to an integer and always stays within `[0, price]`. It is recalculated when the book (price, promotions) or any attached promotion changes, and when a promotion starts or ends.

currentPrice.description: Selling price after promotions in effect. Always between 0 and `price`.

picture.description: Existing image files only. Empty array when the book has no picture.

promotions.description: Active, not yet expired promotions (includes scheduled ones that have not started).

patch.description:
Partially update a book. **Fields not sent are kept unchanged** (no default values are applied).

- `categories` and `promotions`, when sent, **replace** the whole list (`promotions: []` removes all promotions).
- `pictures`, when sent, replaces all pictures.
- `slug`, when sent, is normalized; changing `name` alone does not change `slug`.
- `currentPrice` is recalculated after every update.
- `author`, `publisher`, `publishYear`, `pageCount`, `isbn`, `language` are optional (see the schema for limits); `null` or a blank string clears them.

**Pricing rule.** `currentPrice` (selling price) is computed by the server and cannot be sent: `price` minus the discounts of the promotions attached to the book that are **in effect** (`isActive = true` and `startDate <= now <= endDate`). PERCENTAGE takes off `price * value / 100`, FIXED_AMOUNT takes off `value`, FREE_SHIPPING does not change the price; discounts of several promotions add up. The result is rounded to an integer and always stays within `[0, price]`. It is recalculated when the book (price, promotions) or any attached promotion changes, and when a promotion starts or ends.

post.description: Login to access the system. Wrong email and wrong password both return the same 401 "Invalid email or password.". A disabled account returns 403 only when the password is correct. Sets cookie `refetchToken` (HttpOnly, Max-Age 7 days = 604800s) used by `/refetch-token`.

delete.description: Logout from the system: revokes the current session, so both the access token and the `refetchToken` cookie stop working immediately.

get.description: Get current user information. 401 when the access token is missing, expired or revoked (logout, password/email change).

patch.description: Update the profile of the current user. Only fields sent in the body are updated. Changing password requires `password_old` (400 when missing or wrong). Changing email or password revokes every session (refresh tokens and access tokens) and returns `requireLogin: true`. Blank name, short password or duplicated email return 422 with `fields`.

get.description: Query list of promotions. `search` is either a Prisma `where` JSON, or plain text matched (contains) against `code`, `name`, `description`; plain text equal to a type (`PERCENTAGE`, `FIXED_AMOUNT`, `FREE_SHIPPING`, case-insensitive) also matches `type`.

post.description:
Create promotion. Returns **201**.

Validation: `code`, `name` must not be blank; `code` is unique. PERCENTAGE: `0 < value <= 100`. FIXED_AMOUNT: `value > 0` (VND). FREE_SHIPPING: `value` is ignored and stored as 0. `startDate` must be before `endDate`. Errors → **422** `{ msg, fields }`.

Every create / update / enable / disable / delete recalculates `currentPrice` of the affected books: price minus the discounts of promotions **in effect** (`isActive` and `startDate <= now <= endDate`), rounded, always between 0 and `price`.

books.description: Book ids the promotion applies to. Every id must exist (404 otherwise).
